implementation.summary: MirrorHost's content lambda widened from 3-arg to 4-arg: (MirrorUiState, ImageBitmap?, HierarchySnapshotModel, (MirrorIntent) -> Unit). It collects viewModel.frozenHierarchy (a non-null StateFlow) as state and passes it third, with KDoc recording engineer decision #5 — why the snapshot is NOT reduced into MirrorUiState (its own KDoc keeps a few-hundred-node snapshot out of the reducer because it would be copied on every unrelated reduction) and NOT fetched by a second koinViewModel() resolution (which would rely on two call sites implicitly sharing a ViewModelStoreOwner — true today, silently wrong the day the shell nests one). RectifyWindow.kt: the single call site destructures the new hierarchy param; the sidePanel `if (tab == ShellTab.Notes)` became a `when (tab)` with one new ShellTab.Payload branch calling MirrorPayloadTab(state, frame, hierarchy, onIntent, Modifier.weight(1f)) plus `else -> Unit`; the stale 'Notes is the only tab with content this deliverable' comment was replaced; tabCounts gained ShellTab.Payload to mirror.stagedCount. No new Gradle dependency, no Koin change, and RectifyShellContent's signature is untouched because the sidePanel lambda closes over frame and hierarchy from MirrorHost's scope.

issues: The only possible check on the RectifyWindow.kt edit — :compose-application has no test wiring by design per .claude/rules/testing.md.
Two OOM failures then green serially; orchestrator's own run also green. See troubleshooting.
One import, the lambda destructuring, the when-branch (Notes unchanged + one Payload branch + else), the rewritten stale comment, and one tabCounts entry. Nothing else in the file moved.

Orchestrator verified `git status --porcelain -- *ShellTab.kt *SidePanelFrame.kt *SidebarTabs.kt` is EMPTY. ShellTab already shipped Payload and Cmd+2 -> Payload from the app-shell spec, so the tab was already selectable — it just rendered nothing.
Orchestrator verified exactly one MirrorHost call site repo-wide (RectifyWindow.kt:155); the only other mentions are its own declaration and KDoc. No new Koin binding, no second ViewModel resolution.

The Payload branch passes Modifier.weight(1f) and SidePanelFrame.kt:61 is Column(Modifier.fillMaxHeight()) invoking content(activeTab) inside it, so the ColumnScope has a bounded height and T-10's inner weight(1f) footer pin resolves to real pixels. A load-bearing comment was left at the call site explaining this.

troubleshooting.issue: linkReleaseFrameworkIosArm64 / linkReleaseFrameworkIosSimulatorArm64 failed with 'Compilation failed: Java heap space' on BOTH attempts this wave — not just the first, unlike earlier waves.
troubleshooting.resolution: CHARACTERIZED rather than chased: the implementer isolated it to 4-way parallelism and confirmed the same four tasks pass with --max-workers=1 (BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 1m45s). The iosSimulatorArm64 suites inside the FAILING build were already green (mirror 248/0, core-ui 29/0), and nothing in the diff reaches the linker. Proposed fix for Stage 7 or a standalone infra task: kotlin.native.linkerThreads and/or a higher daemon -Xmx in gradle.properties. Deliberately not done here — that is a shared file and outside T-11's scope.

troubleshooting.issue: BACKLOG DEFECT: T-11's DoD requires 'desktopTest green including the MirrorFakes arity update' and predictedScope lists MirrorFakes.kt as a third file — both rest on a wrong premise.
troubleshooting.resolution: CONFIRMED BY THE ORCHESTRATOR: grep proves ZERO references to MirrorHost anywhere under presentation-feature-mirror/src/commonTest, so widening the lambda broke no fake. The implementer left the file byte-unchanged rather than inventing a no-op edit, and both the desktop and iosSimulatorArm64 test compilations are green at the unchanged 248 baseline — which is itself the proof no fake supplied the 3-arg form. Stage 5 should expect 2 touched paths for T-11, not 3.
